name: Kay Stone
source: Kay is an empath who can read people’s emotion when he touches them. His Rank at the Assistance Corps (AC) is Acolyte. He works at the AC as "The Specialist", and currently is the partner of Lou Reed, the main character. Their first meeting happened in Platypus, a club in Termitary, where Lou and her friends frequent.
